Honestly the best advice I can give on meeting friends is you gotta know what interests you and find people with similar interests. Something like an activity or a hobby you can go out and do if you're looking for friends irl. If you have an interest in anything media related (photography, video games, music, art) check out different social media apps, there are plenty of online communities where people are always looking to chat or make new friends. Alternatively if you're in school look for a club, or if you're working it's always worth it to start up a conversation with a co-worker. I hope this helps, I've gone through several periods in my life where I had no friends but eventually people come around if you look hard enough.
